question: What rules and numbers do the player-owner graphs and the general gameplay feature graphs (gas, heat, contracts, spotting, thermal signature) hold?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/player-features.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Respawn delay (`ActSimEx_PlayerOwner_UpdateOnChange`, 0x0 to 0x8b4): `GameMode_RespawnDelay_Team1/2`, else `DefaultRespawnDelay`, x `Generic_RespawnDelayMultiplier_PerTeam` x `SoldierRespawnDelayMultiplier_PerTeam`; Gauntlet subtracts `Gauntlet_Mission_PlacementRedeployTimeBonus`. In `SimEx_PlayerOwner` the redeploy timer is clamped between `MinRespawnTime` and 150 (a 100 clamp also exists).

Psy gas (`SimEx_PsyGasLogic`): hallucination amount 0..1 with Mid and Top thresholds, snapped to 0 below 0.0001; health regeneration blocked above `PsyGas_BlockHealthRegenThreshold`; damage over time only at hallucination level 2, with no mask, and health at or above 35. Gas volumes apply `Affector_PsyGas_Damage` with parameter 1.1 once per second.

Contracts: every contract-values graph is one game-mode switch (2 battle royale, 3 Conquest, 4 Breakthrough, 13 Tactical Obliteration, 10 unnamed) picking a timer and a count tunable; each objective type needs its kill switch off and its mutator on; drop rates come from `BaseDropRate_<mode>`.
Thermal signature: updated every 0.25 s with 0.25 smoothing and a 0.05 floor; depends on stance, water and speed; a soldier being revived fades toward 0.5.
Spotting: capture-point self-unspot radius 5; Rush objective 8 m for 30 s; suppression above 0.5 spots the suppressor for 5 s; ping and spot durations come from spot-duration tunables.

Heat zone: `Affector_Heat_StatusEffect` with parameter 0.5 every `InsideHeatZone_ExecutionInterval`; dynamic gas stops at 95 % progress (these two were checked by the reader against the 1.4.3.0 bodies only).

inference: Unnamed functions (`14c5568a`, `c0d19a52`, `94263f6f`) leave the spot durations, thermal interpolation and contract-count rounding inferred.
Game-mode numbers are named from the tunables each branch reads.
unresolved: Most of `SimEx_PlayerOwner` and the reward-drop graph are not decoded.
Which of the 150 and 100 clamps applies in which case is not established.
Tunable values are named here but stored elsewhere.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Player and feature graphs read: respawn delay is the per-team mode delay times two per-team multipliers with a 150 upper clamp on the redeploy timer, psy gas damages only at hallucination level 2 without a mask and at 35 health or more, suppression above 0.5 spots the suppressor for 5 s, and objective self-unspot uses 5 m (capture point) and 8 m for 30 s (Rush)
leads.summary: The three player-owner graphs and 51 feature graphs were read; the large player graph and the reward-drop graph are only partly decoded. Respawn delay = per-team mode delay (or the default) x two per-team multipliers, with a Gauntlet bonus subtracted; the redeploy timer is clamped up to 150. Psy gas damage applies only at hallucination level 2, without a mask, at 35 health or more. Suppression above 0.5 spots the suppressor for 5 s. Contract graphs pick tunables by game mode. 12 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: A respawn, gas or spotting number is needed for a claim, or the tunable values are joined.
